title: National Commission Officers' and Employees' Functions

content.scenario: An employee of the National Commission is unsure about the proper procedure to follow in a particular case. The employee seeks guidance from the President of the National Commission.
content.outcome: The officers and other employees of the National Commission shall discharge their functions under the general superintendence of the President of the National Commission.

user_queries: Who supervises the officers and employees of the National Commission?
What is the role of the President of the National Commission in relation to its officers and employees?
How do officers and employees of the National Commission discharge their functions?
